name: dialogProps
label: Recommendation dialog properties

footerLabel.description: Footer label for the recommendation dialog

offsetLeft.description: The left offset for the dialog in the initial render as a percentage

offsetTop.description: The top offset for the dialog in the initial render as a percentage

height.description: The height of the dialog in pixels. Height should be at least 160. If configured less than 160, the component uses a height of 160

width.description: The width of the dialog in pixels. Width should be at least 320. If configured less than 320, the component uses a width of 320

additionalInfo.description: The tooltip text render when the info icon is selected or hovered upon

insertCTALabel.description: The label for the insert CTA in the dialog

refineCount.description: The maximum number of refinements allowed in a single flow.

hideInsertCTA.description: To hide the insert button, set to true

isHoisted.description: To hoist the dialog, set to true

headerInitialLabel.description: Recommendation dialog’s header label when the component loads

headerLoadingLabel.description: Recommendation dialog’s header label when the component is loading

headerLoadedLabel.description: Recommendation dialog’s header label when the component has loaded

fixedVariantInitialLineCount.label: Fixed Variant Initial Line Count
fixedVariantInitialLineCount.description: The maximum number of lines shown in the component’s fixed variant when the component loads

fixedVariantShowMoreLineCount.label: Fixed Variant Show More Line Count
fixedVariantShowMoreLineCount.description: The maximum number of additional lines shown in the component’s fixed variant when the Show more button is selected

enableMultipleDialogs.description: To enable multiple recommendation dialogs of various use cases per page, set to true

isRefreshHidden.description: To hide the refresh button, set to true

isRefreshDisabled.description: To disable the refresh button, set to true

manageRefresh.description: To manage the refresh button, set to true

refreshSummaryHelperText.description: The helper text to show in the refresh summary

refreshSummaryButtonText.description: The button text to show in the refresh summary

closeButtonTooltip.description: The close button tooltip to be shown on hover/focus

description: Configuration of the recommendation dialog’s properties
